candidates.instruction: In `packet_fifo_core`, retain the circular `data_mem`/`last_mem`, read and write pointers, and occupancy logic, but add head data and marker registers that directly drive `out_data` and `out_last`. Load the head on an enqueue into an empty FIFO, and on a dequeue load the next queued tuple; handle a simultaneous dequeue and enqueue when occupancy is one by loading the new input tuple as the head. Preserve stalls, reset behavior, full simultaneous pop/push, all supported WIDTH and DEPTH values, and the top’s `// @latency 1` annotation and observable cycle behavior.
